title: An imported part is tracked and takes its description from the name column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Use a description, description 1, that no part or Part Library entry has.
  • Create an untracked part, part B, for this test at the test location, with 4 in one bin location, bin location A.
  • Have a parts import file made from the Inventory import template with two rows: one that adds part A, with description 1 in the name column, quantity 2 and bin location A, and one for part B with quantity 6 in bin location A.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (Settings, then Data Import, then Inventory).
custom_steps:
1. Upload the file.
  2. Run the import.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes without refusing either row.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed with description 1 in its Description column: the name column became its description.
  • Part A's Total Qty shows 2 Available, a quantity and not "Not Tracked": the import added it as a tracked part.

Step 6:

  • Part B still reads "Not Tracked" in Total Qty, and its Bin Location / Quantity shows bin location A with 6: the import changed its quantity but not its tracking.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S7-N11: “A part the import adds is tracked. The import has no tracking column and never changes an existing part's tracking. The import template's "name" column is the part's description.”
  • S5-E1: “The parts CSV import can change Min, Max and bin quantities on an untracked part. The values are saved the same way as on a tracked part, and a Min or Max change is written to Part History (S10-R22a).”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 16: “(a) Tracked. The import has no tracking column, and it never changes an existing part's tracking. (b) Yes, the "name" column is the part's description (S7-N11).”
